sets.title: Question Type Recognition
sets.description: Choose the correct aspect based on what the question is really asking
sets.descriptionRussian: Выберите правильный вид в зависимости от цели вопроса

items.prompt: Ты _____ Достоевского? (Have you ever read? - experience)
items.hint: Asking about general experience = imperfective past.
items.explanation: Experience question: impf читал. 'Have you ever read?' Not about finishing a specific book.

items.prompt: Ты _____ ту книгу, которую я дал? (Did you finish it? - completion)
items.promptEnglish: Did you finish the book I gave you?
items.hint: Asking about completion of a specific task = perfective.
items.explanation: Completion question: pf прочитал. 'Did you finish reading it?' Specific result expected.

items.prompt: Что ты _____ делать на выходных? (open-ended question about plans)
items.promptEnglish: What are you going to do this weekend?
items.hint: Open-ended question about plans = imperfective future.
items.explanation: Open question: что ты будешь делать (impf). No specific action assumed.

items.prompt: Ты _____ ему? (Will you call him? - specific action)
items.promptEnglish: Will you call him? (about a specific call)
items.explanation: Specific question: pf позвонишь. Asking about one definite call.

items.prompt: Ты _____ этот фильм? (Have you seen it? - general experience)
items.explanation: Experience question: impf смотрел. 'Have you ever watched this film?'

items.prompt: Что ты будешь _____? (What will you drink? - open offer)
items.promptEnglish: What will you have to drink?
items.explanation: Open question: будешь пить (impf). No specific drink assumed yet.

minimalPairs.context: Ты _____ суши? (Have you ever tried sushi? - experience)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Have you ever eaten sushi? (general experience)
minimalPairs.explanation: Experience: impf ел. 'Have you ever eaten sushi in your life?'

minimalPairs.context: Ты _____ суши? (Did you eat the sushi? - completion of a specific portion)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Did you eat the sushi? (the specific sushi on your plate)
minimalPairs.explanation: Completion: pf съел. 'Did you eat IT?' Asking about a specific, completed action.

minimalPairs.context: Ты _____ в Италии? (Have you ever been? - experience)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Have you ever been to Italy?
minimalPairs.explanation: Experience: impf был. Asking about life experience, not a specific trip.

minimalPairs.context: Ты _____ кофе? (Will you have coffee? - specific offer)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Will you have some coffee? (offering a specific drink)
minimalPairs.explanation: Specific offer: pf выпьешь. Offering one cup of coffee.

blanks: Ты когда-нибудь _____ на лошади? (Have you ever ridden a horse?)
Ты _____ задание? (Did you finish the assignment?)
Что вы _____ заказать? (What would you like to order? - open)
hints: Asking about life experience = imperfective past.
Asking about a completed task = perfective.
explanations: Катался (impf) = experience question: ever ridden a horse?
Сделал (pf) = completion question: did you finish it?
Будете заказать > будете заказывать (impf) = open offer: what will you order?

sets.title: Fix and Translate
sets.description: Correct aspect errors in questions and translate
sets.descriptionRussian: Исправьте ошибки вида в вопросах и переведите

errorCorrection.sentence: Ты прочитал Толстого? (meant: have you ever read Tolstoy?)
errorCorrection.explanation: Experience: читал (impf). Прочитал (pf) would ask about finishing a specific book.

errorCorrection.sentence: Ты читал отчёт, который я отправил? (meant: did you finish reading it?)
errorCorrection.hint: Asking about completion of a specific task = perfective.
errorCorrection.explanation: Completion: прочитал (pf). Читал (impf) would only ask 'have you seen it?'

errorCorrection.sentence: Ты позвонишь кому-нибудь? (meant: are you going to be on the phone? open-ended)
errorCorrection.explanation: Open: будешь звонить (impf). Позвонишь (pf) = will you call a specific person?

errorCorrection.sentence: Ты будешь пить этот кофе? (meant: specific - will you drink THIS coffee?)
errorCorrection.hint: Specific offer about THIS item = perfective.
errorCorrection.explanation: Specific: Ты выпьешь этот кофе? (pf). Будешь пить is more open-ended.

translation.english: Have you ever been to Russia?
What are you going to do tomorrow?

minimalPairs.context: Ты _____ ей? (Will you write to her? specific planned action)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Will you write to her? (one specific letter/message)
minimalPairs.explanation: Specific planned action: pf напишешь. One definite letter.

minimalPairs.context: Ты _____ ей? (Are you going to be writing to her? open, ongoing)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Will you keep writing to her? (open-ended, ongoing)
minimalPairs.explanation: Open/ongoing: impf будешь писать. General, no specific endpoint.

sets.title: Context Reading
sets.description: Choose the right aspect based on conversational context

items.prompt: At a dinner party, the host asks: "Вы _____ борщ?" (Have you tried borscht? - experience)
items.hint: Asking about experience with a food = imperfective.
items.explanation: Experience: ели (impf). 'Have you ever tried borscht in your life?'

items.prompt: A boss asks an employee: "Ты _____ отчёт?" (Did you finish the report?)
items.hint: Boss asking about task completion = perfective.
items.explanation: Completion: написал (pf). The boss wants to know if the report is done.

items.prompt: Friends making plans: "Что _____ на выходных?" (What are you doing?)
items.promptEnglish: What are you up to this weekend?
items.explanation: Open: будешь делать (impf). Just asking generally about weekend plans.

items.prompt: In a cafe: "Вы уже _____?" (Have you ordered yet? - asking about a specific action)
items.hint: Asking whether a specific action was completed = perfective.
items.explanation: Specific action: заказали (pf). 'Have you placed your order?'

items.prompt: Meeting someone new: "Вы _____ в Москве?" (Have you been? - experience)
items.explanation: Experience: были (impf). Asking about general life experience.

items.prompt: Teacher to student: "Ты _____ домашнее задание?" (Did you do it?)
items.hint: Expected task - asking about completion = perfective.
items.explanation: Completion: сделал (pf). Teacher expects the homework to be done.

patternRecognition.sentence: Ты читал Пушкина? / Ты слышал эту песню? / Ты пробовал устрицы?
patternRecognition.question: What type of questions are these?
patternRecognition.explanation: All use imperfective past: asking about life experience. 'Have you ever...?'

patternRecognition.sentence: Ты написал письмо? / Ты купил молоко? / Ты позвонил врачу?
patternRecognition.question: What type of questions are these?
patternRecognition.explanation: All use perfective past: asking whether specific tasks were completed.

blanks: Ты когда-нибудь _____ на самолёте? (Have you ever flown?)
Ты _____ билеты на концерт? (Did you buy the tickets?)
Что вы _____ делать после обеда? (What will you do after lunch? - open)
explanations: Летал (impf) + когда-нибудь = life experience: 'Have you ever flown?'
Купил (pf) = did you complete the task of buying tickets?
Будете делать (impf) = open question about plans.

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: All question types mixed in varied exercises
sets.descriptionRussian: Все типы вопросов в разных упражнениях

items.prompt: Ты _____ за границей? (Have you ever worked abroad?)
items.explanation: Experience: работал (impf). 'Have you ever had the experience of working abroad?'

items.prompt: Ты _____ билеты? (Did you book the tickets? - task)
items.explanation: Completion: заказал (pf). Asking about a specific task being done.

items.prompt: Вы _____ чай? (Would you like some tea? - polite offer)
items.explanation: Polite offer: будете пить (impf). More open and polite than pf выпьете.

items.prompt: Ты _____ письмо клиенту? (Did you send the email? - specific task)
items.promptEnglish: Did you send the email to the client?
items.explanation: Task: отправил (pf). Asking whether a specific email was sent.

items.prompt: Ты _____ японскую кухню? (Have you tried it? - experience)
items.explanation: Experience: пробовал (impf). 'Have you ever tried Japanese food?'

items.prompt: "Ты пил это вино?" vs "Ты выпил это вино?" What's the difference?
items.promptEnglish: What's the difference between these two questions?
options: Пил = ever tried? / Выпил = did you drink it all?
items.answer: Пил = ever tried? / Выпил = did you drink it all?
items.explanation: Пил (impf) = 'Have you ever tried this wine?' Выпил (pf) = 'Did you drink it up (the whole glass)?'

errorCorrection.sentence: Вы прочитали Толстого? (meant: have you read Tolstoy in general?)
errorCorrection.explanation: Experience: читали (impf). Прочитали would ask about finishing a specific work.

errorCorrection.sentence: Ты делал домашнее задание? (meant: the teacher asking if homework is complete)
errorCorrection.explanation: Completion: сделал (pf). Делал (impf) only asks 'were you working on it?'

errorCorrection.sentence: Ты напишешь кому-нибудь? (meant: open question about evening plans)
errorCorrection.explanation: Open: будешь писать (impf). Напишешь (pf) = specific person/message.
